contains.app: 1.8.56: the Calendar day view lists every entry with Change and Record what happened; a repeating entry asks 'this occurrence only' or 'this and future occurrences'; recording shows a before-and-after plan comparison that can be closed without undoing the record. 1.8.55: starting finances (cash or owned assets, debts with a calculated payment schedule, pay with fixed or percent deductions), 'every X days' recurrence, and occurrence overrides in the evaluator. 1.8.54: Calendar Add item (a Plan step, an existing item or a new item, then its time; add on the selected days or span across them), a span charges on its last day, routine items (schedule-only), and day boxes ordered by time. 1.8.53: Budget calendar days are coloured by plan risk (CRITICAL / MODERATE / LOW) from the workbook's cash-criticality rule: lowest balance before the next payday under $500 / $1,500, or a $200+ one-off, the rent or a plan step starting that day / within 3 days; blocked plan steps move no money. 1.8.52: calendar days show each step as a box tinted by kind (spending, income, debt payment), side by side with a small gap, wrapping only at the cell edge, with text shrinking until all of it fits and an item count under the date. 1.8.51: an atlas can keep its own Plan (meta.planOwn): the Plan lists only the steps the atlas puts on it, and Calendar or Board items are no longer copied onto it. 1.8.50: atlas handoff (a category's own actual runs until its selected alternative starts), Board sections (sort by category with each section's money), and a plan line on Board rows and Plan steps. 1.8.49: the Plan's step column computes for every step (money, value, requirement) instead of 'not computed'. 1.8.48: the account menu can create the public data repo when it is missing; Register pre-fills a key with Contents and Administration write. 1.8.47: Budget data (encrypted) in the account menu saves Budget's atlas to your data repo sealed with a passphrase (AES-GCM, PBKDF2-SHA-256 600k) and loads it back; Budget's surplus and living cost count spending as spent. 1.8.46: Budget journal (Ash): a Budget Home (month, today, plan and the month's ledger) and journal presentations of the full Calendar, Plan and Expense/Income/Debt/Asset Boards, with one shared hover date picker; other apps keep the stock skin. 1.8.45: Safe area: the platform bar, app picker, menus and apps stay clear of notches, the home indicator and rounded window / screen corners (viewport-fit=cover, env(safe-area-inset-*), plus a corner allowance where devices report no inset). 1.8.44: Budget is the default app and comes first in the app picker; the Fish and Lumen overlay demo apps and their view packs are removed (the platform file is about 0.5 MB smaller). Exp7 stays as an app (lean demo and test harness). 1.8.43: Fixes from Ash's review of 1.8.42: a gradient hover colour no longer turns a skin's face transparent (hover re-emits the node); bold gradient text draws (rich runs turn a gradient colour into the item's paint); a scene placed twice with one placement clipped keeps separate remapped uniforms (images too); non-finite gradient values are rejected in JS; a name longer than its field shows its start with an ellipsis instead of spilling out; demo labels name the vector models. 1.8.42: Gradient paints (linear, two-circle radial, conic; pad / repeat / reflect; any number of stops) on any draw item, and stroked paths (width, miter / round / bevel joins with a miter limit, butt / round / square caps, dashes with an offset) in JRender's draw-list core; JRender.linear / radial / conic and stroke() in the builders, ['stroke', ...] items in JRViews, Exp7VM.linear / radial / conic / strokeItem for skins. Existing scenes tessellate byte-identically. 1.8.41: Renderer fixes from Ash's review: the image layer draws through the renderer's overlay hook instead of replacing draw(), so budgeted off-screen work keeps running; a scene reaching past the canvas gets a valid full-canvas viewport with an exact uniform remap; images use the full-canvas viewport their shader expects. 1.8.40: JRender's wasm is the same dl-index build run through wasm-opt (289,561 B -> 256,009 B); no behaviour change. 1.8.39: Calendar, Board and Plan are vector view models built from the atlas (Exp7VM), with view options, a default skin and per-app tokens; the HTML view builders and the HTML layout path for these views are removed. 1.8.38: the Calendar selection counter follows the selection (it stayed at "0 day(s) selected"). 1.8.37: JRender with an indexed draw-list core (scroll, patch, hover and load no longer walk the whole scene; growth uploads only changed vertices) and a 4 ms frame budget for off-screen tessellation, so on-screen rows are drawn live and the margin catches up. 1.8.36: The parallax holds still while a view scrolls and resumes 160 ms after the last scroll, with no jump; edges redraw only when their drawn offset changes, and frames with nothing to change send no patch and draw nothing extra. 1.8.35: Board scrolling and layout scale with what is on screen: parallax moves only slabs within a screen of the viewport, in 1/8 px steps, and the state-layer layout pass (roomBelow, ground-shadow ids) is linear instead of quadratic, with identical layout output. Board category-name fields are created only for rows near the viewport and added as you scroll. 1.8.34: The old ranking code is gone: no Exp6 JGroup.Best()/SimulatedBest() ranking, fallback or inline kernel copies; JAtlasModel.exp6Order is now rankAlts and JFEngine (Exp7Rank) is the only ranking path. Picks, orders and scores are unchanged. 1.8.33: Exp7 ranks alternatives with JFEngine (Lore jeditor r29) instead of Exp6 JGroup.Best()/SimulatedBest(): each group scores as one batch (jfactor terms through the Exp6 kernel via JFEngine) and ranks by score, highest first, ties in list order, giving the same order as Best() on every shipped group. jfactor() now uses the real Exp6 kernel (method 2). 1.8.32: The Path inspector on the Atlas, Proposal console and Two writers tabs lists the paths the last proposal touched plus a 20-path preview; the full match list is built only while you search it (up to 200), and the Paths tab still lists everything. Opening those tabs no longer lays out all 1,192 rows. 1.8.31: Board values show as the value with its unit, red when consuming and green when not. An item's other buttons sit on a line under it, and item lists start hidden. The Budget date is one button that opens a mini calendar over the view. Board rows move with the pointer again.
